ios.desc:
GeoShred Pro Version 7

With in-app purchases for GeoSWAM and Naada instruments on devices running iOS 13 or later.

Imagine a new kind of musical instrument, an instrument that lets performers fluidly express multiple independent voices. An instrument with continuous pitch control that also helps players precisely land on the right note in any temperament.

GeoShred Pro is an award-winning, deeply expressive musical instrument for multi-touch devices.

Its innovative performance surface features “almost magic” pitch-rounding algorithms and is coupled to physically modeled instruments and effects. GeoShred Pro also supports AUv3, MIDI In/Out, MPE, and 3D Touch. It combines Jordan Rudess’ groundbreaking performance concepts with powerful physically modeled guitar and effects technology based on the research of Dr. Julius O. Smith III of Stanford/CCRMA. GeoShred’s expressive control surface can also be used to play external synthesizers.

300,000 artists in over 120 countries perform with GeoShred, with a strong global community that includes many musicians in India.

Awards include:
• 2nd Place Winner, 2022/2025 MIDI Innovation Award for Software
• Gold Medal Winner, 2019 Denny Award
• Winner, 2019 Guthman New Musical Instrument Award
• Winner, 2017 Electronic Musician Editor’s Choice Award

GeoShred Pro Version 7 Features

• Send/Connect support so GeoShred for iOS/iPadOS can control GeoShred Studio for macOS
• A fluid, expressive playing surface with finger vibrato, slide, and intelligent pitch rounding
• Built-in physically modeled guitar
• Physically modeled effects including Distortion, Wah, EQ, VCF, Flanger, Phaser, Chorus, Tremolo, Reverb, Sympathetic Resonator, Echo Looper, Multi-Tap Echo, Amp and Cabinet Modeling, Modeled Feedback for Guitar, and VCF effects
• In-app purchases for 22 Naada instruments: Bansuri, Bass, Bass Clarinet, Carnatic Violin, Cello, Dizi, Duduk, Erhu, Gaohu, Guan, Nadaswaram, Pan Flute, Pipa, Rudra Veena, Sarangi, Saraswati Veena, Sarod, Shehnai, Sitar, Suona, Viola, and Zhonghu
• In-app purchases for 11 GeoSWAM instruments: GeoViolin, GeoFlute, GeoTenorSax, GeoCello, GeoClarinet, GeoOboe, GeoTrumpet, GeoBassTrombone, GeoBassFlute, GeoViola, and GeoPizzBass
• AUv3 plug-in support with parameter automation
• iCloud preset synchronization
• MIDI/MPE In/Out support
• MIDI configuration presets
• Customizable control surface mapping to physical MIDI controls
• Diatonic keyboard mode, where every key is in the scale
